info.title: PixiShelf mobile reader
info.description: Android preview transport, not a complete public API. Same-origin HTTPS only. All JSON/media responses are private/no-store; never place a token in a URL. Authority: mobile routes, shared Zod validators, and reading-contract.ts.

bearerAuth.description: Signed Better Auth session token returned by POST /session. Browser Cookie is ignored by this transport.

coverUrl.description: Protected same-origin media ID URL; fetch with mediaRevision as revision. Never a filesystem path.

totalMediaSize.description: Same size field as the H5 artwork card DTO, safely represented as a JSON number.

preferredTag.description: First exact name match in the current account preferred_tags order, using the H5 preferred-tag algorithm; null when unmatched.

thumbnailUrl.description: Static thumbnail, longest side at most 512px. No playback or reading observation.

oneOf.description: Observations must be at most 60 seconds old. Video completion uses real playback position >= 90% of duration. Stack evidence is accepted only on VIEW and verified against the current complete logical index.

url.description: Validated HTTPS source identity. Open externally without Authorization, Cookie or mobile credentials.

ArtworkDetail.description: Safe projection of the bounded H5 artwork reader query. Description is plain text; no local paths, management diagnostics, remote embeds or raw HTML. Pair with Reader for reading state and logical media.

Stack.description: Partition of the complete Reader.index before unread filtering. Only a genuinely displayed stack representative may report its matching ruleVersion/fingerprint/groupId evidence; thumbnails and prefetch never report reading.

SetMediaMark.description: Uses the existing account-scoped logical-media mark service. Artwork ownership, activity and file-write locks are rechecked. A single-media like does not change artwork rating.

MarkRead.description: Positive-only manual completion, identical to H5. Does not change visit count, access timestamps or resume position. No reset or unread mutation.

coverUrl.description: Protected same-origin media ID URL; fetch with mediaRevision as revision. Never a filesystem path.

VideoNavigation.description: Bounded registered chapter manifest and published/current-source keyframe timestamps only. Empty arrays when optional data is absent. Does not return source/derived paths or navigation thumbnail URLs.

displayMode.description: Existing account artwork_display_mode; card when unset.

showReadingStatus.description: H5 gallery cards always enable reading status markers; this is not a persisted user setting.
